_doc: Pieces that get ambient occlusion baked into their vertex colours after kiln build (godot/tools/blender/bake_kits.py; S36, owner 2026-11-03). Every loom of a piece (x, x_b, x_c) is baked. Chosen from the review sheets: snow, rocks, rubble and scaffolds gain shape; grass blocks, other floor blocks and autumn foliage stay unbaked because they come out dark. strength 0..1: 0 = unchanged, 1 = full AO.
